summary: Phase 2 RootMC verification complete. Backend: 32/32 pytest passed (all regression + 2 new assertions verifying /checkin/claim & /vote/claim new_wallet_balance now matches /auth/me post-increment via find_one_and_update ReturnDocument.AFTER, + 1 new PWA manifest test). Frontend: all 10 review scenarios verified on live preview at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. TopBar avatar SPA navigation confirmed (URL -> /more, bottom-nav DOM anchor preserved -> no full reload). Player search disabled/enabled thresholds correct (0/2 chars disabled, 3+ enabled) and popup opens rootmc.net/player/?u=Notch. Beta feedback row present. SyncBadge visible on Home, Market, Portfolio. ServerHealthBanner correctly hidden when server online. PWA /manifest.json returns 200 with short_name=RootMC + 2 icons; /service-worker.js returns 200. Rewards gated banner correctly hidden (USE_MOCK=true) and claim button works (+10G, streak-day-1 becomes done, button disabled after). No console errors during full flow.

issues: Sonner success toast (e.g. 'Linked as <user>') stays for ~4s and overlays the top-right avatar area. force=True Playwright clicks still hit the toast; end-users tapping the avatar immediately after login will tap the toast. Consider setting sonner position to bottom-center or reducing default duration, or z-index the top bar above the toast.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py now uses find_one_and_update(return_document=ReturnDocument.AFTER) for both /checkin/claim and /vote/claim — fixes the stale-wallet-balance issue from iteration_1 correctly. new_wallet_balance now matches /auth/me exactly.
server.py is 668 lines — still under the 700-line soft cap but close. Splitting into routers (auth/market/portfolio/rewards) still recommended before further growth.
SyncBadge computes staleness from Date.now() - syncedAt every 15s — correct pattern; loadedAtRef in Rewards.jsx now also uses this pattern so the iteration_1 countdown-stall issue is resolved.

ServerHealthBanner sticky top offset is hardcoded to top-[57px] which assumes the top bar's exact height; if TopBar height changes the banner will overlap. Consider a shared layout token or position:relative in the parent.
usePullToRefresh is applied on Home, Market, Portfolio — good; verify on iOS Safari that overscroll doesn't fight it (not tested in headless Chromium).
rootmc-api.js exports USE_MOCK and LIVE_REWARDS_AVAILABLE from process.env at build time — since REACT_APP_USE_MOCK=true here the gated banner never renders, matching the test expectation.

public/service-worker.js is served correctly via CRA public/ passthrough (200 OK) but is not auto-registered in index.js. If the goal is real PWA install prompts you'll need navigator.serviceWorker.register('/service-worker.js') in index.js — currently the manifest allows install prompt but the SW never activates for users.
